SELECT f.title, c.name AS category_name
FROM film f
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
LIMIT 10;

online_react.question: List the actors who appeared in the film 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'.
online_react.sqlQuery:
SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name
FROM film f
JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id
JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR';

online_react.question: List 5 flights showing the flight number and the airline name.
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT f.flightno, a.airlinename FROM flight f JOIN airline a ON f.airline_id = a.airline_id LIMIT 5;

online_react.question: List 10 film titles and their corresponding language name.
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT f.title, l.name AS language_name FROM film f JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id LIMIT 10;

online_react.question: Show 5 airplanes with their capacity and airline name.
online_react.sqlQuery:
SELECT a.airplane_id, a.capacity, al.airlinename
FROM airplane a
JOIN airline al ON a.airline_id = al.airline_id

online_react.question: How many inventory items are stored at each store ID?
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS inventory_count FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id;

online_react.question: List the top 5 actors who appeared in the most films.
online_react.sqlQuery:
SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count
FROM actor a
JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name
ORDER BY film_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

online_react.question: Show flight number and departure airport city for 5 flights.
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT f.flightno, ag.city FROM flight f JOIN airport a ON f.`from` = a.airport_id JOIN airport_geo ag ON a.airport_id = ag.airport_id LIMIT 5;

online_react.question: What are the 5 most rented films by title?
online_react.sqlQuery:
SELECT f.title, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rentals
FROM film f
JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
GROUP BY f.title
ORDER BY rentals DESC
LIMIT 5;

online_react.question: How many flights depart from airport ID 1 to airport ID 2?
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flight WHERE `from` = 1 AND `to` = 2;

online_react.question: How many films have a length strictly greater than the overall average film length?
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM film WHERE length > (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film);

online_react.question: Which film category has the highest average rental rate?
online_react.sqlQuery:
SELECT c.name AS category_name, AVG(f.rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate
FROM film f
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY avg_rental_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

online_react.question: Which airlines have an average airplane capacity greater than the fleet-wide average?
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT a.airlinename, ac.avg_cap, overall.avg_cap FROM airline a JOIN (SELECT airline_id, AVG(capacity) AS avg_cap FROM airplane GROUP BY airline_id) ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(capacity) AS avg_cap FROM airplane) overall WHERE ac.avg_cap > overall.avg_cap;

online_react.question: How many films in inventory have never been rented?
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS never_rented_count FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE r.inventory_id IS NULL;

online_react.question: What is the total revenue generated by each film category?
online_react.sqlQuery:
SELECT c.name AS category, SUM(f.rental_rate * inv.copies) AS total_revenue
FROM (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies
  FROM inventory
  GROUP BY film_id
) inv
JOIN film f ON inv.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

online_react.question: How many airports have scheduled departures as well as scheduled arrivals?
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fs1.from) AS airport_count FROM flightschedule fs1 JOIN flightschedule fs2 ON fs1.from = fs2.to;

online_react.question: What are the 3 films with the largest number of cast members?
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT f.film_id, f.title, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS cast_count FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY cast_count DESC LIMIT 3;

online_react.question: List 3 flights with the latest arrival dates.
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT flight_id, flightno, arrival FROM flight ORDER BY arrival DESC LIMIT 3;

online_react.question: Which last names are shared by 3 or more actors?
online_react.sqlQuery: SELECT last_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM actor GROUP BY last_name HAVING cnt >= 3;
